scope: Candidate sizing report construction only. No model/device commands, serving-rate edits, candidate selection or score changes.
implementation: Accepts exact four-group runtime policies including BF16 lm_head, if the full policy matches observed autoport registration and has no layer exceptions.
Supports actual server batches 1/8/32 while preserving the advertised 262144-token context and 131072-token working-set planning basis.

Parses actual pre-cache allocator num_banks, launch validation, and cache-allocation events. Derives pool IDs and exact per-ID bytes using the cache dtype, unique tensor_idx groups, K/V pairs, scheduler/physical tile geometry, and the same ceil(tiles/banks)*banks formula as serving_memory.validate_pool_memory.

Checks measured per-device pool bytes equal the geometry-derived total, and rejects non-fitting launches, policy mismatch, unsupported precision, wrong devices, bad shapes, and duplicate/missing evidence events.
Preserves 2854 pool IDs per 131072 working-set agent and 4902 per 262144 full-context agent. Selected agents cannot exceed measured capacity or actual max_num_seqs.
Reports the smallest configured batch for the selected agent count. If a smaller batch could work, it marks that an independent launch is required before selecting it.

New policy outputs use stable gpqa_server_size.json / swe_server_size.json names. Exact legacy stage12_head_bfp8_lofi preserves old *_server_size_head_bfp8.json names; --output-prefix allows explicit policy suffixes.

geometry.basis: Captured identity and pre-cache allocator event plus 60 per-layer cache shapes; BF16 value is a deterministic host-only dtype variant, not a launch measurement.

tests.result: 26 tests passed, including AST verification that the collector tile-byte constants match generator_vllm.py; py_compile passed for collector, tests, pool-budget module, serving adapter and benchmark work estimator.
tests.fixture: Trimmed captured completed B32 head-BFP8/BFP8-KV identity, pre-cache allocator event, launch validation and cache-allocation events. BF16-head/B8 and BF16-KV variants are deterministic host-only transformations, not hardware evidence.
tests.cli_smoke: Ran the collector against the captured completed B32 server identity and log with GPQA10/SWE85 counts; it reconstructed36896 pool IDs at696320 bytes/ID and wrote temporary outputs. GPQA selected10 agents; SWE selected12, both at measured B32.
tests.imports: Collector and tests use standard library only; no TTNN or model imports.

consumer_compatibility.historical_names: Historical head-BFP8 callers retain *_server_size_head_bfp8.json names under the exact legacy precision signature.
consumer_compatibility.new_policy_names: Changed precision policies avoid a false head_bfp8 label by using stable suite_server_size.json names unless an explicit output prefix is supplied.
consumer_compatibility.task_counts: Defaults GPQA10/SWE85; `--task-count` remains a compatibility shorthand for both; new callers can set per-suite counts.
